sources.text:
Rajko's Cave (Serbian: Рајкова пећина, Rajkova pećina) is a cave near the copper and gold mines of Majdanpek in eastern Serbia.


== See also ==
List of caves in Serbia
The Longest Caves And Pits In Serbia
Rajko's Cave
